en.headline: Man dies after collapsing on Wu Kau Tang hike
en.dek: A Government Flying Service helicopter airlifted the hiker from Ha Miu Tin in Tai Po to Eastern Hospital, where he was pronounced dead despite resuscitation efforts.
body: A man died after collapsing while hiking at Ha Miu Tin in Wu Kau Tang, Tai Po, this afternoon, reports said.
Police received a report that two men were hiking when one of them felt unwell and collapsed around 3pm. The Government Flying Service dispatched a helicopter to the scene.
Rescuers used an automated chest compression device while transferring him to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital. He was later confirmed dead.
The circumstances are under investigation. Authorities have not released the man's identity or further details.

zh.headline: 男子大埔烏蛊騰行山暈倒 送院搶救不治
zh.dek: 政府飛行服務隊直升機將事主由烏蛊騰下苗田送往東區醫院，經急救後證實不治。
body: 一名男子今日下午在大埔烏蛊騰下苗田行山時暈倒，送院後不治。
警方接報，兩名男子行山期間，其中一人約下午3時不適昏迷。政府飛行服務隊派出直升機到場救援。
救援人員使用自動心外壓機協助急救，將事主送往東區尤德夫人那打素醫院，最終搶救無效。
事件原因有待調查。當局暫未公布事主身份及其他詳情。
